purpose: Sequenced research backlog for the 40→20→10→5 reconstruction hypothesis. Registration is not evidence of completion.

policy.status_rules: A task is complete only when its declared evidence artifact exists and passes structural, cutoff/leakage, baseline, split and multiple-testing validation. A valid null result completes an analytical task; promotion remains incomplete until the prospective gate reaches at least 100 complete cases (200 preferred) and registered criteria are met.

tasks.title: Validate canonical archive and current run evidence
acceptance: each draw contains five distinct integers 1..40
reconcile canonical archive cutoff with generated metrics and evaluate existing pending shadow freezes without reconstructing missing freezes

tasks.title: Locate where the 40→20→10→5 cascade loses actual numbers
acceptance: per-target ledger contains prior-only cutoff and Top20/Top10/Top5 hit counts for every target/configuration

tasks.title: Build complete ex-ante residual ledger
acceptance: all misses logged only from pre-target forecasts
cutoff date and both global/positional miss flags are explicit
no retrospective substitution of selected numbers

tasks.title: Test frozen mixes inside the same legacy Top20
acceptance: frozen mixes only, no target leakage
constrained mixes preserve the same legacy momentum_20_100 Top20 candidate set while changing only Top10/Top5 order
Top10/Top5 conditional cascade metrics and paired deltas versus the legacy ranking are reported
Holm within the constrained endpoint family and broader Bonferroni correction are reported

tasks.title: Compare global and positional candidate pipelines
acceptance: identical targets and splits for fair comparison

tasks.title: Re-test structural recurrence and hazard as a separate branch
acceptance: conditional randomization null preserving five hits per target

tasks.title: Prospective shadow evaluation and promotion gate
acceptance: at least 100 complete prospective OOS cases; preferably 200+
